class Base { m() { return 1; } get value() { return 3; } }
class OnlyDefault extends Base {
  constructor(
    x = super()
  ) {}
}
class DefaultAndBody extends Base {
  constructor(x = super()) { super(); }
}
class PropDefault extends Base {
  constructor(x = super.m()) { super(); }
}
class PropIndexDefault extends Base {
  constructor(x = super["m"]()) { super(); }
}
class Before extends Base {
  constructor() { console.log(super.m()); super(); }
}
class Getter extends Base {
  constructor() { const read = super.value; super(); }
}
class Conditional extends Base {
  constructor(flag: boolean) {
    if (flag) super();
    console.log(super["value"]);
  }
}
class CallArgument extends Base {
  constructor() { super(super.value); }
}
